badge_scale_legend: Below average is the cheapest quarter, typical is the middle half, above average is the top quarter, well above is the top tenth.

space.label: Glen Manor
space.headline_prefix: A peak-season Saturday dinner in the Glen Manor, before tax and gratuity
space.headline_note: Off-peak and brunch usually cost less.

guest_sensitivity.note: Your guest count starts moving the food cost at about 129 guests. Below that, the minimum is what you pay.

components.title: Food and drink
components.sentence: This space has a $30,000 food and drink minimum - you will not spend less, however small your guest list. Their menu is $233 a head, but below about 129 guests the minimum is what you actually pay.
components.badge_scale: Ranked against 10 comparable Rhode Island venues.

components.title: Ceremony on site
components.sentence: A one-off fee to hold the ceremony here rather than at a church or elsewhere.
components.badge_scale: Ranked against 15 comparable Rhode Island venues.

components.title: Rental fee
components.sentence: A flat charge to book the Glen Manor for the day, before any food or service is added.
components.badge_scale: Ranked against 21 comparable Rhode Island venues.

components.title: Service charge
components.sentence: 16% added to everything above. It is not a tip, and most couples miss it when they budget.
components.badge_scale: Ranked against 12 comparable Rhode Island venues.

components.title: Sales tax
components.sentence: Sales tax is added on top of everything above. This venue did not state its rate.

components.title: Gratuity
components.sentence: Typically 15-20% on top, and separate from the service charge above. Venues that charge both do not always say so up front.

components.title: What you'd pay this venue, before tax and gratuity
components.sentence: Every figure above is this venue's own. Tax and gratuity come on top.
components.scope_note: Room, food and drink, ceremony and service charge. This is not your whole wedding - no flowers, photography, music or attire.

provenance.headline: Every figure here came from this venue

band.sentence: This sits in the middle for Rhode Island. Plenty of venues cost more, plenty cost less.
